Goal persistence / re-anchoring. Structure the prompt to re-anchor agent intent at each turn. Tropelex's Goals are purely passive: nothing re-injects an active goal back into a live agent's working context.

Coordination drift — decline in agreement between multiple agents over time, not just one agent's individual calibration. Nothing currently asks whether they're converging or diverging from each other. That's a real gap, not urgent, but worth remembering.

"Goal Drift" (adherence score δ(t) = 1 − A(t)) is conceptually what score_trend_drift does, just less formalized — we're comparing baseline-vs-recent risk/review-rate, not a proper adherence score against a goal. Worth knowing there's a more rigorous version of the same idea.
